name: Isaiah
title: Isaiah — Holy One of Israel; Servant and King
tagline: Judgment, comfort, and the Child who is Mighty God.

author.traditional: Isaiah son of Amoz (critical theories of multiple authors noted; church receives one prophetic book).

date.range_display: 8th cent. BC ministry (Uzziah to Hezekiah); comfort sections address exile/return horizon.

audience: Judah under Assyrian threat; later exiles; the church.
purpose: Call to trust Yahweh alone; unveil messianic hope.
christ: Virgin-conceived Immanuel; Wonderful Counselor; Suffering Servant; Anointed preacher (Luke 4).
spirit: Spirit upon the Branch and the Servant (11; 42; 61).
jesus_in_this_book: Virgin-conceived Immanuel; Wonderful Counselor; Suffering Servant; Anointed preacher (Luke 4).
how_to_read: Hear courtroom and comfort. Live in 53.
watchman_charge: Woe is me — then here am I. Preach the Servant’s wounds.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
